title: Part Eight: Orders and a Second Sovereign: Jesuits, Opus Dei, Malta

sections.brief: Society of Jesus: Montmartre 1534 vs approval 27 Sep 1540 (Regimini, Formula, 60-member cap, Exposcit debitum 1550); fourth vow re missions and vows against ambition; expulsions 1759-68, suppression 21 Jul 1773, survival in Russia/Prussia, restoration 7 Aug 1814; size 36,038 (1965) to 13,768 (2025); Sosa in office as of Oct 2026, no GC37; what it runs (IAJU 177, 3,629 institutions) and does not (lay boards; no curial office; 1981 papal intervention); Francis first Jesuit pope 2013, Leo XIV Augustinian; myths graded (Monita Secreta, control of papacy). Figures: fig-time (1534-2026), fig-compare (claims graded)

Opus Dei: founded 2 Oct 1928; secular institute 1947/50; personal prelature Ut sit 28 Nov 1982; membership ~93,000 (2% priests, 70% supernumeraries); Ad charisma tuendum (14 Jul 2022: Dicastery for Clergy, prelate not a bishop, annual report) and 8 Aug 2023 canons 295-296; statutes submitted 11 Jun 2025, still in study Feb 2026 / Oct 2026; Franco ministers (contested); former members, FT/El Pais 2024, Gore; Argentina investigation status 11 Sep 2026 with Opus Dei's denial. Figures: fig-time (1928-2026), fig-compare (claims, record and Opus Dei's position)

Order of Malta: Amalfi hospital (11th c.), Paschal II bull 15 Feb 1113, Rhodes 1310-1523, Malta 1530-1798, Rome 1834; sovereignty without territory (extraterritorial seats, Cassation 1974, Brownlie); 118 countries + EU (Order, Sep 2026) vs 114 UN members + Holy See (list); UNGA res 48/265 (24 Aug 1994); Holy See ties (1113, 1930 relations, 1953 tribunal, 2012 recognition); 2016-17 Boeselager crisis; 3 Sep 2022 decree and Dunlap 2023; Malteser International 2024; answer to Ron: connected twice (religious dependence + diplomatic parity) and why it exists; errors fixed (cardinal rank, 48-country passports). Figures: fig-time, fig-compare (Holy See vs Order of Malta)
